subject: Security assessment starter checklist + clarifying questions
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Maria Silva <maria.silva@clearpathhealth.com>, Eric Li <eric.li@clearpathhealth.com>
Cc: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-27T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: Quick recap + next steps from this morning's discovery

Hi Maria / Eric —

Thanks again for taking the time this morning to walk through ClearPath's ingestion flow and the pilot objectives. Per our call, I wanted to summarize the security/compliance items you flagged so we can kick off the questionnaire work and confirm timelines: 

- You indicated SOC 2 Type II is preferred; you currently have SOC 2 Type I in progress (expected completion Q1 2027).
- ClearPath needs HIPAA BAA support for pilot PHI ingestion; legal will want the BAA template and typical timelines.
- Data residency: primary data store must remain in us-west-2 for the first 90 days; long-term residency TBD.
- You asked about our ability to provide a SIG Lite vs full CAIQ — preference is to start with SIG Lite + SOC 2 evidence bundle.

Next steps (proposed):
1) Tessa will send a SIG-lite prefill + clarifying question set today.
2) Maria / Eric to confirm who on your side will own evidence uploads and expected internal procure timeline.
3) Jordan will share a short BAA draft and the typical turnaround for a signed BAA.

If that matches your read, let's start with item #1 today.

Thanks —
Jordan
Jordan Blake
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Maria Silva <maria.silva@clearpathhealth.com>

Cc: Eric Li <eric.li@clearpathhealth.com>, procurement@clearpathhealth.com
Date: 2026-11-27T10:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Quick recap + next steps from this morning's discovery

Jordan —

Thanks for the clear recap. That aligns with what we need. A couple of quick clarifications from our procurement / security intake: 

- SOC status: we can accept a SOC 2 Type I report today, but we need confirmation your SOC scope includes the hosted API and encryption key management (KMS).
- BAA: legal wants an estimate of how long it typically takes for Redwood to sign a BAA once terms are agreed — our timeline for pilot kickoff is mid-Jan, so this matters.
- Evidence owner: I'll be the point for initial uploads but will need a link and a short checklist to hand to our security team.

Please copy procurement@clearpathhealth.com on any contract docs.

Best,
Maria
Director, Compliance & Privacy
ClearPath Health
From: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Maria Silva <maria.silva@clearpathhealth.com>, Eric Li <eric.li@clearpathhealth.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-27T11:30:00-08:00
Subject: SIG-lite starter pack + clarifying questions (one-doc prefill)

Hi Maria / Eric —

Following up with the SIG-lite starter pack we discussed. I attached a prefill PDF that covers the basic CAIQ/SIG fields and a small data residency table (CSV) for your team to review. Below are a set of clarifying questions to help us scope evidence requests more precisely: 

1) SOC scope: Do you need evidence that covers infrastructure (cloud provider controls) only, or must it also include application-level controls (deployment pipeline, runtime RBAC, model access logging)?
2) Encryption: For KMS, do you require customer-managed keys (CMK/HSM) or is provider-managed KMS acceptable for pilot? If CMK is required, we will note additional onboarding steps.
3) Telemetry/PII: Can you confirm types of data elements in pilot records (PHI fields) so we can map redaction/obfuscation options?
4) Retention: You mentioned 90 days in us-west-2 — is that for raw logs, inference inputs, or both?
5) Evidence upload: preferred method — (a) shared Drive link to a folder we create, (b) secure upload to your procurement portal, or (c) direct email to your security inbox?

Suggested timeline: if you can confirm 1–5 by EOD Wednesday 11/30, we will produce a minimal evidence bundle (SOC-I related artifacts + config screenshots) within 3 business days. For SOC 2 Type II artifacts once available, we will update the bundle.

Attachments: redwood_sig_prefill_form.pdf (pdf), redwood_data_residency_table.csv (csv)

Thanks —
Tessa Morgan
Solutions Architect, Security Enablement
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Maria Silva <maria.silva@clearpathhealth.com>, tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-27T13:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: SIG-lite starter pack + clarifying questions (one-doc prefill)

Maria —

Quick note from infra/security on timelines: if ClearPath needs CMKs/HSM for encryption, provisioning and key-scheduling typically adds 2–3 weeks (security review + KMS onboarding). If provider-managed KMS is acceptable for the pilot we can keep the timeline tighter. Also confirming we will include deployment pipeline screenshots and access-control matrix in the initial bundle if you want application-level scope.

On the BAA timing — Jordan, happy to provide the standard BAA template and checklist; signing cadence typically 1–2 weeks if legal has no custom redlines.

Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Security Engineer
Redwood Inference
From: Maria Silva <maria.silva@clearpathhealth.com>
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai, jordan_blake@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@clearpathhealth.com
Date: 2026-11-27T16:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: SIG-lite starter pack + clarifying questions (one-doc prefill)

Thanks — that is all very helpful. Quick answers: 
- SOC scope: we need both infra and application-level controls covered.
- KMS: provider-managed KMS is fine for pilot, we will revisit CMK for production.
- Telemetry: pilot includes names, DOB, and a single identifier; we'll send a sample payload by end of day Wednesday.
- Retention: 90 days for both raw inputs and logs.
- Evidence upload: option (a) shared Drive folder works best for our team. Please send the Drive link and a short checklist for uploads.

Procurement copied — we aim to review the BAA and evidence bundle next week.

Maria
